keyVerseDR: "...it is as a grain of mustard seed..." (Mk 4:31)

level1.title: The Tiny Seed
level1.story: Jesus said God's Kingdom grows like a seed. The mustard seed is tiny, but it grows big! Birds rest in its branches.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did the tiny seed grow into?
What small good thing can you do?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help Your kingdom grow in me. Amen.

activity.title: Tiny seed, big tree
activity.intro: Connect the dots to see the house where the birds can rest.

level2.title: The Seed Grows by Itself
level2.story: Jesus said the kingdom of God is like a man who casts seed into the earth. He sleeps and rises night and day, and the seed springs up and grows while he does not know how. The earth brings forth first the blade, then the ear, then the full corn. Jesus also said the kingdom is like a grain of mustard seed, the smallest of all seeds. When it is sown, it grows up and shoots out great branches, so the birds can dwell under its shadow.
level2.keyLine: It is as a grain of mustard seed.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What small 'seed' of faith can you plant?
actions: Do one small act of faith daily
level2.prayer: Lord, make the seed of faith grow in me. Amen.

activity.title: Imagine the Kingdom
activity.intro: Draw the Kingdom of God growing like a great mustard tree.
activity.prompt: A huge mustard tree grown from a tiny seed, with birds nesting in its branches

art.mainBrief: Tiny mustard seed growing into a big plant with birds
art.heartBrief: Mustard tree growing out of heart
